subtasks.title: Wire Project picker's Browse-for-folder to headless folder picker
subtasks.prompt:
Implement PLAN.md in full, exactly as specified there:

1. src/mainview/lib/api.ts — add `addProject: (path: string) => j<Project>("/projects", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ path }) })` next to `pickProject`/`cloneProject`/`renameProject`, matching their doc-comment style. `Project` is already imported.

2. src/mainview/lib/project-browse-fallback.ts (new) — export `shouldFallbackToHeadlessPicker(error: unknown): boolean` that returns true only when `error instanceof ApiError && error.status === 501`, per PLAN.md's exact code.

3. src/mainview/lib/project-browse-fallback.test.ts (new) — unit tests for the predicate: ApiError status 501 → true; ApiError status 404/500/other → false; plain Error, thrown string, undefined → false.

4. src/mainview/components/kanban/ProjectPicker.tsx — rewrite `onBrowse` to fall back to `api.pickRefs("folder", value || undefined)` + `FolderPickerDialog` (mirroring ReferencesPicker's pattern) strictly when `shouldFallbackToHeadlessPicker` is true on the initial `api.pickProject` failure; add local `dialog` state scoped to this component; add a `registerAndSelect` helper that calls `api.addProject`, `refresh()`, then `onChange`; render `FolderPickerDialog` as a sibling of `CloneProjectDialog`; add `data-testid="project-picker-browse"` to the Browse button. Do not touch CloneProjectDialog wiring or any other part of the file. Follow PLAN.md's code snippets verbatim (imports, state shape, control flow, including the `return` inside `catch` reaching `finally`).

5. e2e/project-picker-browse.spec.ts (new) — follow e2e/folder-picker-dialog.spec.ts's structure and PLAN.md's Tests section: cover AC-1/2/3/5/7 against the `headlessPickBackend` fixture (candidates dialog, pick, cancel), and AC-4 against the default `backend` fixture (direct resolution, no dialog). Use `gotoApp` directly — no task creation needed since ProjectPicker lives on the always-mounted NewTaskForm.

Do not modify src/bun/server.ts, ReferencesPicker.tsx, or FolderPickerDialog.tsx — all confirmed unchanged in PLAN.md. Run `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` (including the new unit test file) before finishing; the e2e spec should also be runnable per repo conventions.
